product: The partner-powered AI features setting will be removed
tagline: On November 1, 2026, Databricks will remove the account and workspace level toggle for partner powered AI features.
what_it_does: On November 1, 2026, Databricks will remove the account and workspace level toggle for partner powered AI features. Each workspace will keep its current setting value: if the setting is enabled, it stays enabled, and if it's disabled, it stays disabled. Removing the toggle doesn't change any setting values.
why_it_matters: By default, this setting is enabled for all workspaces that do not have a compliance security profile (CSP) enabled.
plain_summary: On November 1, 2026, Databricks will remove the account and workspace level toggle for partner powered AI features. Each workspace will keep its current setting value: if the setting is enabled, it stays enabled, and if it's disabled, it stays disabled.
key_takeaway: On November 1, 2026, Databricks will remove the account and workspace level toggle for partner powered AI features.
